patents.patent_title: Multi-track continuous control thrust lever for aircraft
patents.patent_abstract: A thrust lever assembly having forward and reverse lever tracks with discrete detent positions and path switching for aircraft engine control.

patents.patent_title: Throttle lever haptic vibration alert with performance modulation
patents.patent_abstract: A throttle lever configured to vibrate asymmetrically to alert a pilot of engine thrust imbalance, integrated with FADEC feedback.
An autothrottle system with dynamic virtual detents for thrust setting, integrated with FADEC via EEC.
